## Why This Is Asked
Assesses practical drift-detection, feature governance, and automated retraining in a multi-region SageMaker setup.

## Key Concepts
- Data quality and feature-drift monitoring
- SageMaker Feature Store and Model Monitor
- SageMaker Pipelines and canary rollouts
- PrivateLink, governance, data provenance

## Code Example
```python
import numpy as np
def kl(p, q):
    p = p / p.sum()
    q = q / q.sum()
    return float(np.sum(np.where((p>0)&(q>0), p * np.log(p/q), 0)))
```
